description: Issue #141 recall check (ADR 0001): the primary pass misses a one-way indemnification in Section 10 and ACCEPTs; the critic raises it with its own edit. The final review must REQUEST_CHANGE, carry the critic's issue and insert the critic's replacement.

clauses.heading: 8. Limitation on Liability
clauses.text: $150,000 mutual aggregate liability cap; mutual exclusion of consequential, special, punitive, incidental, and indirect damages; no implied warranties beyond those expressly set forth.

clauses.heading: 10. Indemnification
clauses.text: The Company shall indemnify Institution for any and all claims, without limit.

primary.verdict_summary: No changes identified relative to your standard positions.

issues.counterparty_change_summary: Counterparty introduced one-way indemnification of Institution by the Company.
issues.external_rationale_for_footnote: One-way indemnification by the Company is not an acceptable position.
issues.replacement_scope_note: The clause states the opposite position outright, so the correct term cannot be reached by a local repair.

critic.verdict_summary: One issue identified in Section 10 requiring attention before your organization can accept this draft.

segments.text: The Company shall indemnify Institution for any and all claims, without limit.
Neither party shall bear responsibility for defending or compensating the other party for third-party claims arising under this Agreement, except as expressly and narrowly set forth in Section 8.
